Advanced ATC

Browse Advanced ATC terms for pilots, air traffic controllers, cabin crew and aviation learners.

Languages

ArabicDeutschEnglishEspanolFrancaisHindiBahasa IndonesiaItalianoJapanesePortuguesRusskiyThaiTurkceVietnameseZhongwen

Alcance visual de pista setenta y cinco metros

Reported horizontal distance a pilot can see runway markings or lights, measured at 75 metres for CAT IIIB minima.

View term

Alimentación por Ethernet en aviónica

A system that delivers both power and data over Ethernet cables to avionics equipment, reducing wiring complexity and enabling flexible installations (ARINC 429, ARINC 664).

View term

Análisis de macrodatos

The use of advanced computing techniques to analyze vast amounts of operational data, supporting safety, efficiency, and predictive maintenance in aviation (ICAO Doc 10140).

View term

Aprobación de navegación basada en el rendimiento

An operational authorisation indicating an aircraft and crew are approved to operate using specific performance-based navigation specifications such as RNAV and RNP, in accordance with ICAO Doc 9613.

View term

Aprobación del mínimo de separación vertical reducida

An official authorisation for an aircraft and operator to use Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum (RVSM) airspace, allowing reduced vertical separation of 1,000 feet between FL290 and FL410, in accordance with ICAO Doc 9574.

View term

Aproximación con rendimiento de navegación requerido y autorización

A specific approach procedure requiring both Required Navigation Performance (RNP) and explicit operational authorisation, used in airspace or at airports with demanding performance and monitoring requirements (ICAO Doc 9613).

View term

Aproximación ILS Categoría II

Precision approach using ILS equipment with decision height not lower than 100 ft and RVR not less than 300 m.

View term

Aproximación ILS Categoría IIIA

ILS precision approach with decision height below 100 ft and RVR not less than 200 m; autopilot or HUD guidance required.

View term

Aproximación ILS Categoría IIIB

ILS precision autoland with no decision height or below 50 ft and RVR as low as 75 m, requiring fail-operational capability.

View term

Auditoría de seguridad de operaciones en línea

An observational safety program in which trained auditors monitor routine flight operations to identify threats and errors and recommend safety improvements (ICAO Doc 9803, FAA).

View term

Banda ancha aire-tierra de cuarta generación

A broadband communication system using 4G/LTE technology to provide high-speed data links between aircraft and ground stations (ICAO GANP, SESAR).

View term

Bolsa de vuelo electrónica clase dos

A portable EFB device that may be temporarily connected to aircraft power/data during flight but is stowed after use (FAA AC 120-76D).

View term

Bolsa de vuelo electrónica clase tres

A permanently installed EFB system fully integrated with aircraft power and data, certified as part of aircraft avionics (FAA AC 120-76D, EASA AMC 20-25).

View term

Bolsa de vuelo electrónica clase uno

A portable, non-mounted device (typically a commercial tablet or laptop) used for flight planning, charts, and manuals, not connected to aircraft data or power (FAA AC 120-76D).

View term

Categoría II con autorización especial

A precision approach and landing operation using Category II minima that requires special authorisation by the state of the operator and additional operational, equipment, and crew qualifications (ICAO Doc 9365, PANS-OPS Vol I).

View term

Categoría III con autorización especial

A precision instrument approach and landing operation with the lowest decision heights and runway visual range (RVR), requiring special authorisation, specific aircraft and crew certification, and strict adherence to Category III minima (ICAO Doc 9365).

View term

Comunicaciones de datos

Digital message exchange between air traffic control and aircraft, including CPDLC, ADS-C, and other datalink systems for clearances, instructions, and information (ICAO Doc 10037, GOLD).

View term

Comunicaciones por enlace de datos controlador-piloto

A digital communication system that enables the exchange of messages between air traffic controllers and pilots via data link, used primarily in oceanic, remote, and high-density airspace for clearances, instructions, and reports. (ICAO Doc 4444, GOLD)

View term

Comunicaciones por enlace de datos controlador-piloto

A digital communication system enabling direct message exchange between air traffic controllers and pilots via data link, primarily used in oceanic, remote, and high-density airspace for clearances, instructions, and reports (ICAO Doc 4444, GOLD).

View term

Comunicaciones satelitales banda L

Satellite-based communication for aircraft using L-band frequencies (1–2 GHz), supporting global voice and data links (ICAO Doc 9869, ARINC 741).

View term

Conectividad C-Band de quinta generación

A communications system using 5G cellular technology in the C-band spectrum for high-speed, low-latency data transfer to and from aircraft (ICAO GANP, SESAR).

View term

Contrato de vigilancia dependiente automática

A formal agreement, electronically established between an aircraft and ATC ground station, specifying when position, intent, and status reports are automatically transmitted via ADS-C (ICAO Doc 4444, GOLD).

View term

Despegue con empuje reducido

Take-off using less than maximum rated thrust by performance calculation, saving engine life and fuel.

View term

Empuje derate

Engine rated for lower maximum take-off thrust than certification limit, permanently reducing stress and maintenance costs.

View term

Endurecimiento de ciberseguridad

The process of applying security measures to reduce cyberattack risk on aircraft systems and networks (EASA, ICAO Doc 10117).

View term

Enlace de datos de alta frecuencia

A long-range communication system enabling digital message exchange between aircraft and ground stations via high-frequency (HF) radio bands, often used for ATC datalink in oceanic and remote airspace (ICAO Doc 10037).

View term

Estación terrestre GBAS

A ground-based transmitter providing precision approach and landing guidance by augmenting GNSS signals for aircraft at equipped airports (ICAO Doc 9849, FAA AC 150/5300-13).

View term

Estado de monitoreo centralizado electrónico de aeronave

A system status or advisory displayed on the Electronic Centralised Aircraft Monitoring (ECAM) system, indicating real-time aircraft systems information, warnings, or required actions for pilots (Airbus FCOM, ICAO).

View term

Estado del sistema de aterrizaje

Cockpit annunciation indicating availability and health of localizer, glide-slope and autoland monitoring channels.

View term

Ethernet conmutado full-dúplex para aviónica

A deterministic, high-speed, full-duplex switched Ethernet network designed specifically for critical avionics systems, providing reliable, low-latency data exchange between aircraft systems (ARINC 664, Part 7).

View term

Exención de Lista de Equipo Mínimo

The operational allowance permitting dispatch or continued operation of an aircraft with certain inoperative items, as listed in the approved Minimum Equipment List (ICAO Doc 9760, MEL Policy).

View term

Garantía de calidad de operaciones de vuelo

A program for analyzing digital flight data to identify, assess, and mitigate operational safety risks, supporting proactive safety management (ICAO Doc 10000, FAA AC 120-82).

View term

Gestión de energía

Pilot technique balancing airspeed and altitude by trading potential and kinetic energy for efficient trajectory control.

View term

Gestión de información a nivel de sistema

A global aviation data-sharing infrastructure standardizing information exchange among ATM stakeholders, improving situational awareness and efficiency (ICAO Doc 10039).

View term

Gestión del riesgo de fatiga

A systematic approach by operators to monitor and manage crew fatigue risk, including procedures, training, and reporting, in compliance with ICAO and EASA regulations (ICAO Doc 9966).

View term

Grabador de acceso rápido

An on-board device that rapidly records selected flight parameters for operational monitoring and safety analysis, with quick data download capability (ICAO Annex 6).

View term

Herramienta de separación de tráfico aéreo

A controller support system that calculates optimal spacing between arriving and departing aircraft to maximize runway efficiency and safety (FAA NextGen, SESAR).

View term

Inspección de mantenimiento de nivel A

A scheduled, routine maintenance check performed at regular intervals to ensure the continued airworthiness of the aircraft, typically involving inspections and minor servicing tasks as prescribed by the maintenance program (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).

View term

Inspección de mantenimiento de nivel C

A comprehensive periodic maintenance inspection performed at longer intervals than A- or B-Checks, involving in-depth systems checks, component replacements, and structural inspections as prescribed by regulatory maintenance programs (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).

View term

Inspección de mantenimiento mayor de nivel D

An extensive, scheduled maintenance inspection that involves major disassembly, overhaul, and comprehensive structural and systems checks, typically performed every 6–12 years to ensure long-term airworthiness (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).

View term

Inspección de motor por boroscopio

A maintenance procedure using a borescope device to visually inspect the internal components of an aircraft engine for defects or damage (FAA AC 33-6, EASA Part 145).

View term

Interferencia en el sistema mundial de navegación por satélite

Any deliberate or accidental disruption of GNSS signals affecting navigation and surveillance for aircraft, including jamming and signal loss (ICAO Annex 10, EASA SIB 2019-08R1).

View term

Investigación de gestión del tráfico aéreo del Cielo Único Europeo

A pan-European collaborative project (SESAR) for research and development of next-generation air traffic management, standardizing procedures and technology across Europe (EU ATM Master Plan, ICAO).

View term

Mantenimiento predictivo

A maintenance approach using data analytics, sensors, and machine learning to predict equipment failures and schedule repairs before faults occur (ICAO Doc 10140, FAA).

View term

Matriz de evaluación de condiciones de pista

A standardized tool used to report runway surface condition for operational decision-making, using runway condition codes (RWYCC) per ICAO/FAA harmonized methodology.

View term

Mensaje de subida de enlace de datos controlador-piloto

A digital message sent from ATC to the flight deck over the Controller-Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC) system, including clearances, instructions, or information (ICAO GOLD).

View term

Mensaje del sistema de indicación de motor y alerta a la tripulación

A visual and/or aural alert generated by the Engine Indication and Crew Alerting System (EICAS or ECAM) to inform pilots of engine status, malfunctions, or required actions according to the system logic (ICAO, FAA AC 25-11A).

View term

Modo autoland fail-operational

Autoland logic able to complete flare, touchdown and rollout after any single-component failure below alert height.

View term

Modo autoland fail-passive

Autoland configuration where a single failure causes autopilot disengage but leaves aircraft in trim, allowing manual landing continuation.

View term

Monitoreo de salud del motor

Continuous or periodic analysis of engine data to assess performance, detect faults, and schedule maintenance (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA AC 33-16).

View term

Navegación basada en el rendimiento

A framework for area navigation based on required performance standards for accuracy, integrity, and functionality (ICAO Doc 9613).

View term

Navegación de Área con Rendimiento de Navegación Requerido

A navigation specification for aircraft that combines Area Navigation (RNAV) with defined Required Navigation Performance (RNP) standards, indicating the precision and monitoring required in a given airspace or procedure, in accordance with ICAO Doc 9613.

View term

Notificación digital a los aviadores

A machine-readable NOTAM provided in digital format for direct integration into flight planning, EFBs, and avionics systems, ensuring timely and accurate distribution of aeronautical information (ICAO Doc 10066).

View term

Operaciones basadas en trayectorias

A concept where aircraft operations are planned, managed, and executed based on a shared, predicted four-dimensional trajectory, enhancing airspace capacity and efficiency (ICAO Doc 9971).

View term

Pantalla head-up

Transparent cockpit display showing critical flight data within the pilot’s forward field of view, reducing the need to look down at instruments.

View term

Plan de vuelo electrónico

A digitally filed and managed flight plan, submitted electronically to ATC, airlines, and relevant authorities, allowing automated processing, distribution, and amendment (ICAO Doc 4444, FAA AIM).

View term

Procedimientos de baja visibilidad

Aerodrome ground-movement and approach rules activated whenever reported runway visual range falls below published minima.

View term

Proceso de arranque seguro

A cryptographic method that ensures only authorized software can be loaded on avionics systems during startup (EASA, ICAO Doc 10117).

View term

Proceso del sistema de gestión de la seguridad

A structured set of procedures within an SMS for identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational safety risks in aviation organizations (ICAO Doc 9859, FAA AC 120-92B).

View term

Protección alpha-floor

Autothrust safeguard that commands maximum thrust if angle-of-attack approaches stall, preventing loss of lift.

View term

Protección beta-target

Flight-laws function holding safe sideslip target during engine-out or crosswind approach to maintain directional control.

View term

Rechazo de despegue a baja velocidad

A rejected take-off initiated at a speed below V1 due to abnormal indications, system failure, or runway hazard (ICAO Doc 4444, FAA AIM 4‑3‑10).

View term

Red de datos aeronáuticos ARINC 664

ARINC 664, also known as AFDX, is a deterministic Ethernet network protocol for reliable, high-speed data communications between avionics subsystems on aircraft.

View term

Red Ethernet de aviónica

A high-speed, deterministic digital data network based on Ethernet technology, used to interconnect avionics systems on modern aircraft (ARINC 664, AFDX).

View term

Red inalámbrica de la cabina de vuelo

A secure Wi-Fi network within the cockpit for connecting Electronic Flight Bags, avionics, or crew devices, isolated from passenger cabin networks (FAA, EASA AMC 20-25).

View term

Rendimiento de comunicaciones requerido 240

A globally standardized measure for communications capability, latency, and integrity in airspace—‘240’ indicates message transaction time ≤240 seconds (ICAO Doc 9869).

View term

Reversión del aviso de resolución del sistema de alerta de tráfico y prevención de colisiones

An updated TCAS alert that instructs the flight crew to reverse a previously issued vertical avoidance maneuver due to a change in conflicting traffic behavior (ICAO Doc 9863, FAA AIM).

View term

Satélite de alta capacidad

A new generation of satellite technology providing much greater data capacity and bandwidth to aircraft for broadband connectivity (FAA, ICAO GANP).

View term

Secuenciación en punto de fusión

A terminal arrival procedure in which aircraft from different routes are directed to a predefined merge point and sequenced for final approach (ICAO Doc 9931, FAA NextGen).

View term

Seguridad de capa de transporte para aviónica

The use of cryptographic protocols (TLS/SSL) to protect avionics network data in transit from unauthorized access or tampering (ICAO Doc 10117, EASA AMC 20-42).

View term

Seguridad de la red de la aeronave

Protection of aircraft networks from unauthorized access, cyberattacks, and data breaches, ensuring the integrity of onboard systems (EASA, ICAO Doc 10117).

View term

Separación basada en el tiempo

A separation technique in which aircraft are spaced by time intervals instead of distance to maximize runway throughput, especially in strong headwind conditions (ICAO Doc 4444, SESAR).

View term

Servicio digital automático de información terminal

A system that provides pre-recorded, digital, real-time airport and weather information to pilots automatically (ICAO Doc 4444, FAA AIM 4‑1‑13).

View term

Servicio Europeo de Superposición de Navegación Geoestacionaria

The European SBAS providing GNSS augmentation for safety-critical aviation operations, enabling APV and LPV approaches across Europe (ICAO Doc 9849, EASA AMC 20-28).

View term

Sistema de aterrizaje automático

Integrated avionics that guides aircraft from glide-slope capture through flare and rollout without pilot control inputs.

View term

Sistema de aterrizaje GBAS

A precision approach and landing system using GNSS signals enhanced by a Ground-Based Augmentation System (GBAS), providing Category I–III approach capabilities (ICAO Doc 9849, Annex 10).

View term

Sistema de aumentación basado en satélites

A satellite navigation system that augments GNSS signals, providing improved accuracy, integrity, and availability for aviation, including SBAS services like WAAS, EGNOS, GAGAN, and MSAS (ICAO Annex 10, Doc 9849).

View term

Sistema de aumentación basado en tierra

A system that enhances the accuracy, integrity, and availability of GNSS signals for aviation by providing local ground-based corrections, used for precision approach and landing (ICAO Doc 9849, Annex 10).

View term

Sistema de aumentación de área amplia

A U.S.-based Satellite-Based Augmentation System (SBAS) that enhances GPS accuracy, integrity, and availability for all phases of flight, enabling precision approaches with LPV minima (FAA AIM, ICAO Doc 9849).

View term

Sistema de aumentación por satélite multifuncional

Japan’s Satellite-Based Augmentation System providing GNSS augmentation for aviation, enabling precision approaches at airports in the region (ICAO Doc 9849, JCAB Guidance).

View term

Sistema de gestión de información digital de terreno y obstáculos

A database system providing real-time digital terrain and obstacle data for flight planning, situational awareness, and navigation safety (ICAO Doc 9881, Annex 15).

View term

Sistema de guía de visión sintética

A cockpit display system that provides pilots with a computer-generated, real-time, 3D depiction of terrain, obstacles, and runways using position and navigation data.

View term

Sistema de guía y control de movimientos en superficie

A comprehensive system of lighting, signs, and procedures to support safe and efficient aircraft movement on the ground, especially in low visibility (ICAO Doc 9476, FAA AC 120-57).

View term

Sistema de transporte aéreo de próxima generación

The United States’ initiative (NextGen) to modernize the national airspace system, integrating new technologies, automation, and procedures for increased safety, efficiency, and capacity (FAA NextGen, ICAO Doc 9854).

View term

Sistema de visión mejorada

Onboard system using infrared or millimeter wave cameras to improve pilot visibility of runway, terrain, and obstacles in poor visibility (ICAO Doc 9365, FAA AC 20-167A).

View term

Sistema Futuro de Navegación Aérea uno-alfa

An ICAO standard for data link communications in oceanic and remote airspace; FANS 1/A enables CPDLC and ADS-C functions for advanced controller-pilot communications (ICAO Doc 9869, GOLD).

View term

Suplantación del sistema mundial de navegación por satélite

A deliberate electronic attack that manipulates GNSS signals to provide false position or timing data to aircraft, endangering navigation and surveillance integrity (ICAO Annex 10, EASA SIB 2020-07).

View term

Temperatura flexible asumida

Artificially higher temperature entered in FMS to calculate reduced-thrust take-off setting (flex) within performance limits.

View term

Transmisión automática dependiente de vigilancia - In

A surveillance function enabling an aircraft to receive and display ADS-B broadcasts from other aircraft, increasing situational awareness (ICAO Annex 10, FAA AIM).

View term

Transmisión automática dependiente de vigilancia - Out

A surveillance technology in which an aircraft automatically broadcasts its position, velocity, and identification derived from GNSS, used by ATC and other aircraft (ICAO Annex 10, Doc 4444).

View term

Trayectoria de cuatro dimensiones

A predicted or managed aircraft flight path defined by latitude, longitude, altitude, and time—core to Trajectory-Based Operations (ICAO Doc 9971).

View term

Trayectoria inicial de cuatro dimensiones

The first shared, predicted trajectory of an aircraft, including latitude, longitude, altitude, and time, used in Trajectory-Based Operations for collaborative airspace management (ICAO Doc 9971).

View term

Vector ruta de vuelo

Symbol on HUD or PFD showing instantaneous trajectory of aircraft relative to horizon and runway aiming point.

View term

Verificación de capacitación basada en computadora

A mandatory electronic assessment verifying that aircrew or ATC personnel have completed required computer-based training modules in accordance with regulatory standards (ICAO Doc 9868, EASA AMC1).

View term
